secretHelpHeader: Pick a project secret or create one. The value is sent as this header when the agent runs and is never shown again.
secretHelpQuery: Pick a project secret or create one. The value is sent as this query parameter when the agent runs and is never shown again.
secretHelpUrl: Pick a project secret or create one. The value is put into the address when the agent runs and is never shown again.
urlSecretReplaces: The secret replaces {{placeholder}} when Agenta calls the server. It is never stored in the URL.
urlSecretSetSendAs: This URL contains {{placeholder}}. Set Send as to In the URL so the secret replaces it.
notAnMcpServer: Reached the address, but it isn't an MCP server.
unsupportedTransport: This address uses the older SSE transport, which Agenta does not support.
urlKeyRejectedAdvice: Check where {secret} sits in the URL, or pick another secret.
queryKeyRejectedAdvice: Check the query parameter the server expects, or pick another secret.
keyRejectedAdvice: Check the header the server expects, or pick another secret.
refusedWithoutKey: The server refused a connection without a key.
refusedWithoutKeyStatus: The server refused a connection without a key ({{status}}).
newerTransportAdvice: Many providers serve the newer transport at an address ending in /mcp. Check the provider's docs.
unreachableAdvice: Check the address and that the server speaks HTTP transport. Private-network servers must be reachable from Agenta.
urlHelp: The server's HTTP endpoint. Agenta checks it and detects whether it needs OAuth, an API key, or nothing.
legacyTransportWarning: This address may use the older SSE transport, which Agenta does not support. Many providers serve the newer transport at an address ending in /mcp. Check the provider's docs.
name: Name
nameHelp: What the model sees on this server's tools. Frozen when the connection was chosen, so renaming the connection does not rename tools here.
namePrefixHint: Shown across this project. Tools are prefixed {{prefix}}_
oauthNotice: Connect opens {{name}}'s authorization page in a new window; {{name}} asks which permissions to grant (usually read and write). The login is stored for this project only.
waitingBody: Finish in the window that opened. Sign in to the provider if it asks, then approve Agenta. This closes on its own when you're done.
savedOauthUnreadable: The saved OAuth settings could not be read. Try again.
consentCancelled: {{name}} didn't authorize Agenta. The sign-in was cancelled or denied. Nothing was saved.
